newsitem.title: USA: Coach to acquire four companies.
newsitem.headline: Coach to acquire four companies.

text.p: Coach USA Inc., the nation's largest provider of motorcoach tour and charter services, said Monday it plans to acquire with four companies with combined annual revenues of $90 million.

The companies are Antelope Valley Bus Inc. of Lancaster, Calif., International Express Corp. of Minneapolis, Minn., Kerrville Bus Co. of Kerrville, Texas, and Red & Tan Enterprises Inc. of Bergenfield, N.J.
The acquisitions would increase Houston-based Coach's annualized revenues to over $350 million, it said.

"With these transactions, some of the premier leaders in the motorcoach industry join Coach USA," said Coach Chairman and Chief Executive Richard Kristinik. "Their companies add substantially to our already strong position in Los Angeles, northern New Jersey and Texas. We also added an airport transportation company in Minneapolis."

The acqiusition of one of the companies, which has revenues of $20 million, would be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests. The other three businesses, with combined revenues of $70 million would be accounted for as purchases.
Coach's stock edged up 25 cents to $32.25 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
